Aspera Connect — employee downloads
===================================

Share these two links (same branch, always latest files):

PC (Linux) — AsperaConnect-Desktop.deb  (0.1.0-beta.4)
  https://github.com/ramchandragada/asperaconnect/raw/cursor/phone-contacts-sync-5b4f/dist/release/AsperaConnect-Desktop.deb

Phone (Android) — AsperaConnect-Phone.apk  (0.3.10)
  https://github.com/ramchandragada/asperaconnect/raw/cursor/phone-contacts-sync-5b4f/dist/release/AsperaConnect-Phone.apk

Install guide:
  https://github.com/ramchandragada/asperaconnect/raw/cursor/phone-contacts-sync-5b4f/dist/release/INSTALL.txt

If something fails:
  https://github.com/ramchandragada/asperaconnect/raw/cursor/phone-contacts-sync-5b4f/dist/release/TROUBLESHOOTING.txt


PC install (Ubuntu / Mint / Zorin)
---------------------------------
1. Download the .deb (link above)
2. Double-click → Install
   or:
   sudo apt install -y ./AsperaConnect-Desktop.deb
3. Open "Aspera Connect" from the app menu
   (not Aspera Hub, not "Aspera Connect Call")
4. If an old copy was installed from ~/.local/bin, remove it:
   mv ~/.local/bin/aspera-connect ~/.local/bin/aspera-connect.old 2>/dev/null || true


Phone install
-------------
1. Open the .apk link on the phone → Download → Install
   (allow Install unknown apps for Chrome/Files if asked)
2. Or from PC with USB:
   adb install -r AsperaConnect-Phone.apk
3. Open app → allow permissions → Start for calls
4. Check version shows v0.3.10


Pair (any network — no IP typing)
---------------------------------
1. PC: Phone calls → Show QR to pair
2. Phone: Scan PC QR
   (No camera: PC Copy pair code → phone Paste pair code)
3. Done

Cloud relay (already live): wss://aspera-connect-relay.onrender.com
First pair after long idle may take ~1 minute (free server wake-up).
